title: Disproving the Single Level Conjecture
author: Stasys Jukna
observations: The paper distinguishes single-level monotone circuits from unrestricted monotone circuits.
Its K(t,t)-free lower-bound discussion and Lemma3.13 explicitly concern single-level circuits, so this source does not justify a general clean-gate normalization for the present target.
scope: Research orientation only; no theorem from this paper is used as a Lean axiom or as an unproved premise of the target proof.
inference: An unrestricted 22-gate lower bound for this graph still needs an independent argument; the checked clean-circuit bound does not settle it.
